# klika.ph

> Donate to verified Filipino causes, earn KliKa Points, and redeem real rewards. A mobile-first donation and rewards platform.

klika.ph connects donors, fundraisers, and verified beneficiary organizations across the Philippines. Donors earn points for every peso given, fundraisers earn a share for referred donations, and beneficiaries receive transparent allocations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with how it works, rewards, and FAQ.
- [Discover causes](/campaigns): Browse verified, active campaigns by category.
- [Browse campaigns](/campaigns): All active and recent campaigns.
- [Beneficiaries](/beneficiaries): Verified NGOs and partner organizations.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top donors and fundraisers.
- [Rewards](/rewards): Vouchers, merch, and partner perks redeemable with KliKa Points.
- [Help](/help): Guides and answers about donating, points, and payouts.
- [Join as fundraiser](/join): Sign up to refer donations and earn a share.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access for donors and fundraisers.
